notes.title: Balance Update: Weapon and Ability Adjustments
notes.notes:
We actively listen to your feedback - the community helps us drive the game forward. Thanks to your engagement, we’ve prepared a fresh balance update!

🔧 Balance changes in this update:
 Increased throw range of the RGO grenade - now 6 tiles
 Increased armor damage from the RGO grenade by 1
 Underbarrel grenade launcher now requires 7 AP to fire (previously 14)
 All RPGs now require 14 AP to fire (previously 18)
 The "Suppressive Fire" ability now requires 14 AP (previously 3)
 Sniper rifle reload now costs 14 AP (was 13)
 LMG reload now costs 13 AP (was 14)
 LMG firing now costs 8 AP (was 10)
 The "Inspiration" ability now grants 6 AP (previously 2)
⚙️ New stats mean new tactics. Rebuild your squad and adapt to the fight!

notes.title: Update – July 20, 2025
notes.notes:
We’re happy to announce that we’ve fixed the issue causing the game to unexpectedly crash during the launch of Mission 7: "Anomalies."

Thank you for reporting this bug and for your patience! Your feedback helps us improve the game.

notes.title: Future War Tactics: SOF vs Alien Invasion - Full Release!
notes.notes:
Full release of Future War Tactics: SOF vs Alien Invasion! 👽

Commanders, it’s time to lead an elite squad and strike back against the alien invasion! ⚔️ After months of hard work and your feedback, Future War Tactics: SOF vs Alien Invasion launches on July 17!

Get ready for intense turn-based battles, smart tactics, and a massive campaign. Assemble your squad, customize your gear, and prove that Earth won’t go down without a fight! 🌍

The future is in your hands. Ready for battle?
